title: Unconfirmed reporting path with InformationReport-style PDU
purpose: Add unconfirmed/reporting-path diversity absent from the four candidate plans by using the documented MMS Unconfirmed-PDU tag, improving parser coverage beyond repeated confirmed-service requests.
expected_behavior: A parser with MMS unconfirmed-service support should recognize the 0xA3 Unconfirmed-PDU path and continue into reporting-style message handling rather than confirmed-service dispatch.
constraints_preserved: For MMS over RFC1006, prefer a TPKT header beginning with version 0x03.
Keep the TPKT total-length field consistent with the complete message.
Diversify association, discovery, read, write and reporting paths.
Use a distinct MMS PDU type tag from confirmed-request coverage.
issue_safety_notes: This is a safe reporting-path seed using a short, well-formed unconfirmed MMS wrapper. It does not reuse any historical crash payload and introduces no malformed octet-string or invalid shift-exponent condition.
